newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct fixed-asset funds up 18.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct fixed-asset funds up 18.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's investment in fixed assets rose 18.6 percent to 949.7 billion yuan ($114.4 billion) in the January-October period, compared with the same period a year ago, the Liberation Army Daily said on Friday.
The growth rate for the 10 months was down 0.6 percentage point from the same period last year, the newspaper quoted figures from the State Statistical Bureau as showing.

Investment in capital construction reached 512.6 billion yuan during the 10 months, up a year-on-year 11.8 percent, the newspaper said. However, the growth rate was down 7.7 percentage points from last year, the newspaper said.

Spending on renovation and upgrading grew a year-on-year 14.3 percent in the period to 197.7 billion yuan. That was 4.4 percentage points higher than the figure for the same period last year, it said.
The State Statistical Bureau had forecast that investment in 131 major state projects would reach 155.2 billion yuan this year, surpassing the planned amount for the year, it said.
